manifest.title_fil: Mag-ulat at suriin ang sariling tugon
objectives_fil: Sa sitwasyon ni Elena, gumawa ng maikling handover na may sinabi, ginawa at susunod na hakbang, at pumili ng isang pagpapabuti.
objectives_en: Given Elena’s situation, make a brief handover with the report, action and next step, then choose one improvement.

sections.takeaway_fil: Alamin ang alalahanin bago pumili ng tugon.
sections.takeaway_en: Find out the concern before choosing a response.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sumulat ng tatlong linyang handover tungkol kay Elena. Ipasuri sa kapareha kung may hula o hindi kailangang detalye. Tukuyin ang isang pagbabago sa susunod.
sections.takeaway_en: Write a three-line handover about Elena. Ask a partner to check for assumptions or unnecessary details. Identify one change for next time.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ito ang tanong na sinabi niya at mahalaga sa susunod na usapan.
sections.takeaway_en: This is what she asked and is relevant to the next conversation.

check.prompt_fil: Aling detalye ang dapat isama ni Datu sa handover tungkol kay Elena?
check.prompt_en: Which detail should Datu include in Elena’s handover?

options.fil: “Mahirap kausap at maraming tanong si Elena.”
options.en: “Elena is difficult and asks many questions.”

options.fil: “Nagtanong siya kung sino ang makakakita ng form.”
options.en: “She asked who can see the form.”

options.fil: “Ayaw niyang may makaalam ng totoong buhay niya.”
options.en: “She does not want anyone to know her real life.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Bansag ito sa tao at hindi malinaw na paglalarawan ng alalahanin. 2: Ito ang tanong na sinabi niya at mahalaga sa susunod na usapan. 3: Hula ito sa motibo ni Elena, hindi nakumpirmang impormasyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: This labels the person rather than describing the concern. 2: This is what she asked and is relevant to the next conversation. 3: This guesses Elena’s motive rather than reporting confirmed information.

sections.takeaway_fil: Inihihiwalay ang tanong ni Elena sa hula, pinapangalanan ang tamang tatanggap, itinatala ang kasunduan at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti.
sections.takeaway_en: Separates Elena’s question from assumptions, names the appropriate recipient, records the agreement and chooses one specific improvement.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi ng tulong sa tamang tao kapag lampas sa saklaw.
sections.takeaway_en: Seek the appropriate support when a situation exceeds your role.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyak itong pagbabago na maaari niyang subukan at suriin.
sections.takeaway_en: This is a specific change he can try and review.

check.prompt_fil: Naipasa na ni Datu ang handover. Ano ang makabuluhang pagninilay?
check.prompt_en: Datu has handed over the concern. Which reflection is useful?

options.fil: Mag-alok ng pribadong lugar nang mas maaga sa susunod.
options.en: Offer a private place earlier next time.

options.fil: Iwasan na ang lahat ng residenteng maraming tanong.
options.en: Avoid all residents who ask many questions.

options.fil: Sabihing maayos ang lahat kahit hindi nakinig nang buo.
options.en: Say everything went well despite not fully listening.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tiyak itong pagbabago na maaari niyang subukan at suriin. 2: Hindi nito pinabubuti ang sariling pakikitungo o access sa serbisyo. 3: Hindi nito sinusuri ang aktuwal na nangyari o kailangang baguhin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a specific change he can try and review. 2: This does not improve his response or access to service. 3: This does not examine what happened or what needs to change.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng isang hakbang at balikan ang naging resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose one action and follow up on the result.

assets.caption_fil: Inihihiwalay ang tanong ni Elena sa hula, pinapangalanan ang tamang tatanggap, itinatala ang kasunduan at pumipili ng isang tiyak na pagpapabuti.
assets.caption_en: Separates Elena’s question from assumptions, names the appropriate recipient, records the agreement and chooses one specific improvement.
